Postgres.PORT: Private PostgreSQL listener; never publish a TCP proxy.
Postgres.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generate once and preserve; references feed both application services.
Postgres.PGDATA: Durable cluster subdirectory inside the database volume.

Worker.PORT: Private recipe readiness endpoint; no public domain.
Worker.AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY: Generate once; database gate refuses a different signing secret.
Worker.AUTHENTIK_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD: Initial akadmin password, not a restart-time password rotation mechanism.
Worker.AUTHENTIK_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN: Initial privileged API token; revoke in authentik after confirming setup.
Worker.AUTHENTIK_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL: Set your real administrator email before empty-database bootstrap.
Worker.AUTHENTIK_OUTPOSTS__DISCOVER: Must remain false; Docker/Kubernetes discovery excluded.
Worker.AUTHENTIK_OUTPOSTS__DISABLE_EMBEDDED_OUT: Must remain true; proxy outposts excluded.

Server.PORT: HTTP target 9000 behind Railway HTTPS termination.
Server.AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY: Stable reference to Worker's generated signing/encryption secret.
Server.AUTHENTIK_LISTEN__TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS: Trust only loopback and Railway internal proxy CIDR; validate forwarding in staging.
Server.RECIPE_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT: Server binds nothing before durable worker approval; 30–1800 seconds.

common.AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__NAME: Reference to the durable database name.
common.AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD: Reference to the one generated database password.
common.AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__SSLMODE: Private-network plaintext database transport; assess compliance or add verified TLS.
common.AUTHENTIK_OUTPOSTS__DISCOVER: False; never enable automatic outpost provisioning.
common.AUTHENTIK_ERROR_REPORTING__ENABLED: Disable upstream error telemetry by default.
common.AUTHENTIK_LISTEN__HTTP: IPv6/private-network capable HTTP listener on port 9000.
common.AUTHENTIK_LISTEN__HTTPS: Loopback-only container TLS listener; Railway terminates external TLS.
common.AUTHENTIK_LISTEN__TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS: Trusted forwarders; verify against deployment topology.
